SessionStart.description: Opt-in baseline: when the project is activated (acv.config.json present), ensures .acv/ is gitignored, then writes an HMAC-signed snapshot of git-tracked files to .acv/session-start.json. Inert (writes nothing) when not activated.

PreToolUse.description: Denies writes to test files (per settings.test_path_allowlist) unless the caller is the test-author subagent. Emits hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision = 'deny'.

PostToolUse.description: Runs the reward-hacking watchdog (AST for JS/TS, heuristics for Python) plus a path/content guard on production writes; emits decision:block with a reason on SUSPICIOUS patterns (eval/exec, assertion monkeypatching, degenerate impls, test logic outside the allowlist). Persists findings to .acv/findings.jsonl when activated.

Stop.description: Tamper-evident gate: when the project is activated, blocks the stop if any unresolved SUSPICIOUS finding exists, or the Auditor verification receipt is missing/invalid, or the Verification-Quality Score is below the configured floor, or a score delta regressed. Inert when not activated.

SubagentStop.description: Applies the Stop gate when a subagent stops: a success claim requires no unresolved SUSPICIOUS findings and a valid receipt. Inert when not activated.

PreCompact.description: Blocks compaction while unresolved SUSPICIOUS verdicts exist in .acv/findings.jsonl (honors pre_compact_block_on_suspicious). Inert when not activated.
